interpretation_notes: concepts.json declares family, word and accepted surface/token variants, but no narrower species, territorial, construction or culinary sense field. Ordinary meanings are used; consequential unresolved subtype/sense differences are flagged.

The names judgment follows CHECKLIST: own concept/variants or family synonyms. A narrower taxon is not automatically a synonym of the broad family. Accidental substrings that do not name a concept are not treated as semantic naming.

Decisiveness is a semantic judgment with the concept and siblings visible and the 128-member bank available; it is not a blind answer-generation experiment. Realistic bank alternatives are considered. Marked status never supplies the judgment.
General clauses need not be universal quantification over pathological exceptions; explicit can/often/some qualifiers matter. Substantial ordinary variety/sense conflicts are recorded as unknown.

Targeted primary/official factual checks were permitted external reading, unrelated to human judgments or sampling. Proposed rewrites still require author review and the later mechanical token/name checks.
